note: docs/protocols/map-server-node.md, the Mine switch: the line a Land owner signs as a Land message's Message. Every valid line parses to its fields, and building those fields gives the same line; every invalid one is refused. Threads is checked against the Node's maxThreads by the Map server, not by the grammar.
